import asyncio


async def callbacks(users, register, save):
    for user in users:

        async def callback():
            async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
                group.create_task(save(user))

        register(callback)


async def nested(users, rows, register, save):
    for user in users:

        async def callback():
            for row in rows:
                # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
                async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
                    group.create_task(save(row))

        register(callback)
